title: Latest insider trades
description: Most recent SEC Form 4 insider transactions (US stocks), parsed to clean JSON within minutes of filing. Filter by type (P=open-market buy, S=sale) and minimum dollar value.

type.description: Form 4 transaction code: P (buy), S (sale), A (grant), M (option exercise)…

title: Insider activity for a stock
description: All insider buys and sells for one ticker over a window, with a summary: buy vs sell dollar value, distinct buyers/sellers and a net_buying / net_selling signal.

title: Insider cluster buying
description: Stocks where several different insiders bought shares on the open market in the same window — one of the strongest public insider signals. Ranked by number of insiders and dollar value.

title: Top prediction markets
description: Highest-volume live prediction markets across Polymarket and Kalshi with implied probabilities, 24h change, volume and close time. Refreshed every 15 minutes.

title: Search prediction markets
description: Find the market-implied probability of any event (elections, Fed decisions, sports, crypto, geopolitics) across Polymarket and Kalshi by keyword.

title: Prediction market movers
description: Markets whose implied probability moved the most in the last 24h — what the crowd suddenly changed its mind about. Filtered by minimum volume.

title: US macro dashboard
description: Latest value, change and year-over-year % for 24 key US indicators: CPI, core CPI, PCE, payrolls, unemployment, jobless claims, Fed funds, 2y/10y/30y yields, curve, mortgages, GDP, M2, Fed balance sheet, dollar index.

title: Macro time series
description: History (up to ~260 observations) plus summary stats for one US macro series by FRED id.

id.description: FRED series id, e.g. CPIAUCSL, UNRATE, DGS10

title: Economic release calendar
description: Upcoming US economic data releases (CPI, jobs report, GDP, etc.) for the next N days.

title: x402 agent-economy overview
description: State of the x402 agent economy from the full Bazaar catalogue: services, endpoints, 30-day paid calls, estimated USDC volume, demand by category, network mix, top services, and how much volume comes from a handful of wallets (concentrated / likely self-traffic). Refreshed every cycle.

title: x402 service rankings
description: Ranked x402 services (by 30-day calls, unique payers or estimated revenue) with endpoint count, median price, networks and a concentration flag that filters out services whose volume comes from fewer than 5 wallets. Filter by category.

category.description: ai_inference, trading_defi, onchain_data, market_data, search_scrape, social, media, infra, travel, other

include_concentrated.description: true to include services with volume from <5 wallets

title: Find a paid API for a task
description: Agents: describe what you need ('weather forecast', 'token price', 'transcribe audio') and get matching x402 endpoints ranked by real usage, with price, method, network and recent activity. Decoy/honeypot endpoints (≥$1000) are excluded.

max_price.description: Maximum price per call in USD, e.g. 0.01

title: Trending x402 services
description: Which x402 services gained or lost the most paid calls versus N days ago, plus new entrants — built from our daily snapshots of the whole catalogue.

days.description: Compare with N days ago, 1-90, default 7

title: x402 price benchmarks
description: What paid agent APIs cost, per category: 25th/50th/75th percentile price, free share, and the median price of endpoints that actually get paid calls. For sellers setting prices and buyers checking value.
